title: Agricultural supply chain organization and analysis

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and analyze agricultural supply chains, including rice, seafood, and fruit industries.
Analyze economic factors and policies affecting agricultural supply chains.
Conduct independent research and present findings on agricultural supply chains.
Apply critical thinking to solve problems in agricultural supply chain management.
Collaborate effectively in group projects and presentations.
Effectively present research findings and analysis in group settings.
Develop self-learning habits to enhance understanding of agricultural supply chains.
